items.body: At this time only Patches and above can post their ships. Prospects are considered new and have a high likelihood or either not staying with the Org or the game in general. So in order to mitigate hundreds of extra ships on the hanger of players who are not active with the Org we decided to make it Patch and above. Hopefully everyone understands everyone

items.title: What Prospects can now do
items.body:
- Prospect — Now have Read Only access level.
- View the Fleet Terminal and shared Org Fleet Registry.
- Browse the Pilot Directory.
- View ships, loadouts, and photos that members have chosen to share.
They cannot add, edit, delete, import, or share ships. everyone

items.title: **__NEW SDAS FEATURE — TOP 5 ISSUE COUNCIL!__**
items.body:
Good Friends. Bad Ideas. Legendary Stories. And occasionally, a few bugs.
Dudes, we’ve added a brand-new feature to SDAS.space designed to help our organization make a difference in the development of Star Citizen!
Introducing the SDAS TOP 5 ISSUE COUNCIL!
CHECK IT OUT HERE:
https://sdas.space/#issue-council
WHAT IS IT?
We’ve created a dedicated section on our website that highlights five Star Citizen bugs or issues we want to bring to the community’s attention.
Rather than simply complaining about broken missions, disappearing cargo, or whatever else the ‘verse throws at us, we can now help bring those issues to CIG’s attention through the official Issue Council.
